question: Should this durable cron ownership representation be accepted as the canonical upgrade path for existing stored jobs and interrupted runs?
rationale: The PR changes persisted run-to-job association and restart recovery semantics; that compatibility boundary needs an owner decision beyond ordinary test review.

options.title: Accept the ownership model after proof
options.body: Confirm legacy-store and interrupted-run compatibility, then merge with an inspectable redacted Gateway transcript or artifact.

options.title: Narrow the persistence boundary
options.body: Require a smaller ownership representation or an explicit migration path if maintainers do not want these new durable fields written to every cron row.

recommendation.title: Accept the ownership model after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm legacy-store and interrupted-run compatibility, then merge with an inspectable redacted Gateway transcript or artifact.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation and linked reproduction establish the strongest available context for the proposed cron ownership contract.
